💼 Business Tourism

Business Tourism in China

Arab Trader's Guide – Canton Fair, Yiwu markets, import and export with escort and translation services

💼 Business Guide⏱️ 10 min read
Home◂Tourism in China◂Business Tourism

China is the world's largest exporter and the number one center for global manufacturing and trade. Millions of merchants and businesspeople from Arab countries visit China annually to participate in trade fairs and visit wholesale markets. Arcadia Tourism offers customized business trips that combine work and tourism, with professional translation and escort services.

Canton International Fair 🏢

The Canton Fair in Guangzhou is China's largest and oldest trade fair since 1957, held twice a year in spring and autumn. It attracts more than 200,000 international buyers and includes thousands of exhibitors in all sectors from electronics and machinery to textiles and food.

⭐ Arcadia Services for Traders at Canton Fair

We provide special packages including: hotel reservations near the fair, private Chinese-Arabic translator, car with driver, assistance in negotiations with suppliers, and factory visit arrangements.

Yiwu Markets 🛒

Yiwu is the world's capital of small goods. Its international trading market is the world's largest wholesale market for consumer goods – more than 5 million square meters and 75,000 stores. You can find everything at factory prices. We recommend allocating 3–5 days to cover all sections.

Importing from China – Beginner's Guide 📦

Basic steps: identify the product and quantity, find reliable suppliers through trade fairs or field visits, request samples and inspect quality, negotiate price and shipping terms. Check travel tips for details on the business visa.

Top Commercial Cities 🏙️

In addition to Guangzhou and Yiwu: Shenzhen – electronics capital, Foshan – furniture and ceramics center, Hangzhou – Alibaba headquarters. You can combine business visits with tourist activities and halal restaurants.

💡 Tips for Traders

Check cost of tourism in China to estimate your business trip budget, and the halal food guide to find the best restaurants in commercial cities.
